description: Unit tests for the HPACK decoder tables in HTTP/2, including static and dynamic table content verification, table resizing, and insertion tests.

classes.name: HpackDecoderTablesPeer
classes.description: Provides access to internal details of HpackDecoderTables for testing.

classes.name: HpackDecoderStaticTableTest
classes.description: Test fixture for static table content verification.

classes.name: HpackDecoderTablesTest
classes.description: Test fixture for dynamic table operations, including insertion, trimming, and resizing.

methods.name: num_dynamic_entries
methods.description: Returns the number of dynamic entries in the table.

methods.name: MakeSpecStaticEntries
methods.description: Creates a vector of predefined static table entries.

methods.name: ShuffleCollection
methods.description: Randomly shuffles a collection using Http2Random.

methods.name: VerifyStaticTableContents
methods.description: Verifies the static table contents match expected entries.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a header pair by index.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Calculates size of header name and value.

methods.name: FakeInsert
methods.description: Inserts a fake header entry into the simulated dynamic table.

methods.name: FakeSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of fake dynamic table entries.

methods.name: FakeTrim
methods.description: Trims fake dynamic table entries to fit within size limit.

methods.name: VerifyDynamicTableContents
methods.description: Verifies actual dynamic table matches fake dynamic table.

methods.name: DynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Updates the dynamic table size limit and verifies correctness.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a header into the dynamic table and verifies table integrity.
